import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int B = 1000000;
    static final long P1 = 998244353L;
    static final long P2 = 1000000007L;
    static long n, cnt;
    static List<Integer>[] val = new ArrayList[7];
    static int answer;
    static long[] sum_vals = new long[7];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            val[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        generateVals(0, 0);
        for (int d = 0; d <= 6; d++) {
            Collections.sort(val[d]);
            for (int x : val[d]) {
                sum_vals[d] = (sum_vals[d] + x) % P2;
            }
        }
        answer = 0;
        cnt = 0;
        process(0, 0L);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    static void generateVals(int depth, long value) {
        cnt++;
        val[depth].add((int)((cnt - value + P1) % P1));
        if (depth == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            generateVals(depth + 1, value * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static void process(int depth, long v) {
        if (v > n) return;
        if (depth != 0) {
            if (v * B > n / 10 && (v + 1) * B - 1 <= n) {
                for (int i = 0, power = 1; i <= 6; i++, power *= 10) {
                    long coefficient = (cnt - (v * power) % P1 + P1) % P1;
                    int idx = lowerBound(val[i], (int)(P1 - coefficient));
                    answer = (int)((answer + coefficient * val[i].size() + sum_vals[i]) % P2);
                    answer = (int)((answer - (P1 * (val[i].size() - idx)) % P2 + P2) % P2);
                }
                for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                    cnt += val[i].size();
                }
                return;
            }
            answer = (int)((answer + (++cnt - v % P1 + P1) % P1) % P2);
        }
        for (int c = (depth == 0 ? 1 : 0); c < 10; c++) {
            process(depth + 1, v * 10 + c);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
